## Checklist

- [ ] There's an issue for this change, and a maintainer agreed with the approach
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-off-dco)
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] If this touches `skills/`, `schema/`, `bin/` or `.claude-plugin/`: a line under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] No tokens, private URLs or personal data in code, docs, screenshots or examples
